summary: Gerdau S.A., a Brazilian steel producer, filed a Form 6-K with its 1Q26 earnings release, reviewing financial results and operational highlights. The filing announces a share buyback program at Metalúrgica Gerdau S.A. for up to 10 million preferred shares, a dividend payment of R$0.18/share plus R$0.08/share, and a Gerdau S.A. buyback program for up to 56.4 million shares. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation events; this is a routine earnings update without structural corporate actions. No deal terms or material special-situations activity is present.
